src_sentence: For example, players of marbles games might wager marbles, and likewise games of Pogs or Magic: The Gathering can be played with the collectible game pieces (respectively, small discs and trading cards) as stakes, resulting in a metagame regarding the value of a player's collection of pieces.

src_sentence: Fixed-odds betting and Parimutuel betting frequently occur at many types of sporting events, and political elections.

src_sentence: The outcome of the wager is often immediate, such as a single roll of dice, a spin of a roulette wheel, or a horse crossing the finish line, but longer time frames are also common, allowing wagers on the outcome of a future sports contest or even an entire sports season.
translation: दांव का परिणाम अक्सर तत्काल होता है, जैसे पासा का एक ही रोल, रूले व्हील का घूमना, या फिनिश लाइन को पार करने वाला अश्वधावन, लेकिन लंबी समय सीमा भी आम है, जिससे भविष्य के खेल प्रतियोगिता के परिणाम या पूरे खेल के मौसम पर भी दांव लगाने की अनुमति मिलती है।

src_sentence: Since these high payoffs have very low probability, a house bias can quite easily be missed unless the devices are checked carefully.

src_sentence: In the mid-20th century, illegal gambling was common.

src_sentence: Some parish pastors have also opposed casinos for the additional reason that they would take customers away from church bingo and annual festivals where games such as blackjack, roulette, craps, and poker are used for fundraising.

src_sentence: In addition to organized sports betting, both legal and illegal, there are many side-betting games played by casual groups of spectators, such as NCAA basketball tournament Bracket Pools, Super Bowl Squares, Fantasy Sports Leagues with monetary entry fees and winnings, and in-person spectator games like Moundball.
translation: संगठित खेल सट्टेबाजी के अलावा, कानूनी और अवैध दोनों तरह से, आकस्मिक दर्शकों के समूहों द्वारा कई साइड-बेटिंग गेम खेले जाते हैं, जैसे एनसीएए बास्केटबॉल टूर्नामेंट ब्रैकेट पूल, सुपर बाउल स्क्वायर, मौद्रिक प्रवेश शुल्क और जीत के साथ फंतासी खेल लीग, और इन-पर्सन स्पेक्टेटर गेम जैसे माउंटबॉल।

src_sentence: The Buddha stated gambling as a source of destruction in Singalovada Sutra.

src_sentence: Many jurisdictions, both local and national, either ban gambling or tightly regulate it by licensing vendors.

src_sentence: Gambling games that take place outside of casinos include bingo (as played in the US and UK), dead pool, lotteries, pull-tab games and scratchcards, and Mahjong.
translation: कैसीनो के बाहर होने वाले जुआ खेलों में बिंगो (जैसा कि अमेरिका और ब्रिटेन में खेला जाता है), डेड पूल, लॉटरी खेल, पुल-टैब गेम और स्क्रैचकार्ड और माहजंग शामिल हैं।

src_sentence: Many betting systems have been created in an attempt to "beat the house" but no system can make a mathematically unprofitable bet in terms of expected value profitable over time.
translation: "हाउस को हराने" के प्रयास में कई सट्टेबाजी प्रणालियाँ बनाई गई हैं, लेकिन कोई भी प्रणाली प्रत्याशा मान के संदर्भ में गणितीय रूप से unprofitable शर्त को समय के साथ लाभदायक नहीं बना सकती है।

src_sentence: Arbitrage betting is a theoretically risk-free betting system in which every outcome of an event is bet upon so that a known profit will be made by the bettor upon completion of the event regardless of the outcome.
translation: आर्बिट्रेज सट्टेबाजी एक सैद्धांतिक रूप से जोखिम-मुक्त सट्टेबाजी प्रणाली है जिसमें किसी घटना के हर परिणाम पर दांव लगाया जाता है ताकि परिणाम की परवाह किए बिना घटना के पूरा होने पर सट्टेबाज द्वारा एक ज्ञात लाभ कमाया जा सके।

src_sentence: In Lipkin Gorman v Karpnale Ltd, where a solicitor used stolen funds to gamble at a casino, the House of Lords overruled the High Court's previous verdict, adjudicating that the casino return the stolen funds less those subject to any change of position defence.

src_sentence: Gambling is also a major international commercial activity, with the legal gambling market totaling an estimated $335 billion in 2009.

src_sentence: Playing cards appeared in the 9th century CE in China.
translation: ताश के पत्ते चीन में 9वीं शताब्दी आम युग में दिखाई दिए।

src_sentence: For these social and religious reasons, most legal jurisdictions limit gambling, as advocated by Pascal.

src_sentence: Gamblers may exhibit a number of cognitive and motivational biases that distort the perceived odds of events and that influence their preferences for gambles.
translation: जुआरी कई संज्ञानात्मक और प्रेरक पूर्वाग्रहों का प्रदर्शन कर सकते हैं जो घटनाओं के कथित ऑड्स को विकृत करते हैं और जो जुए के लिए उनकी प्राथमिकताओं को प्रभावित करते हैं।

src_sentence: By the early 20th century, gambling was almost uniformly outlawed throughout the U.S. and thus became a largely illegal activity, helping to spur the growth of the mafia and other criminal organizations.
translation: 20वीं सदी की शुरुआत तक, संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका में जुआ लगभग समान रूप से गैरकानूनी घोषित कर दिया गया था और इस प्रकार बड़े पैमाने पर एक अवैध गतिविधि बन गया, जिससे माफिया और अन्य आपराधिक संगठनों के विकास को बढ़ावा मिला।

src_sentence: There is generally legislation requiring that gambling devices be statistically random, to prevent manufacturers from making some high-payoff results impossible.

src_sentence: The word gaming is used more frequently since the rise of computer and video games to describe activities that do not necessarily involve wagering, especially online gaming, with the new usage still not having displaced the old usage as the primary definition in common dictionaries.

src_sentence: Although the Bible does not condemn gambling, the desire to get rich is called to account numerous times in the New Testament.

src_sentence: Gambling (also known as betting or gaming) is the wagering of something of value ("the stakes") on a random event with the intent of winning something else of value, where instances of strategy are discounted.

src_sentence: Gambling views among Protestants vary, with some either discouraging or forbidding their members from participation in gambling.

src_sentence: Betting exchanges allow consumers to both back and lay at odds of their choice.
